results.description: Striking Blow: You suffer a Minor Head Injury.
Minor Head Wound: You suffer a Minor Head Injury and gain 1 Bleeding Condition.
Pummeled: You suffer a Minor Head Injury and gain the Stunned Condition.
Cracked Skull: You suffer a Fractured Skull and gain 2 Bleeding Conditions.
Devastated Eye: You suffer a Minor Head Injury and are Blinded in one eye.
Decapitated: Your head is separated from your body. You are dead.
Jarred Arm: You drop anything held in that hand.
Minor Arm Wound: You gain 1 Bleeding Condition.
Badly Cut Arm: You drop anything held and gain 2 Bleeding Conditions.
Broken Arm: The arm is broken. You suffer a Fractured Arm and drop anything held.
Mangled Arm: The arm is Torn. You drop anything held.
Severed Arm: The arm is Amputated and you gain 2 Bleeding Conditions.
Winded: You gain the Stunned Condition.
Minor Chest Wound: You gain 1 Bleeding Condition.
Gaping Chest Wound: You gain the Prone Condition and 2 Bleeding Conditions.
Crushed Ribs: You suffer Fractured Ribs and gain the Prone and Stunned Conditions.
Gutted: You are Torn and gain the Prone Condition and 3 Bleeding Conditions.
Heart Pierced: Your heart is pierced. You are dead.
Jarred Leg: You gain the Prone Condition.
Minor Leg Wound: You gain 1 Bleeding Condition.
Badly Cut Leg: You gain the Prone Condition and 2 Bleeding Conditions.
Broken Leg: You suffer a Fractured Leg and gain the Prone Condition.
Mangled Leg: The leg is Torn. You gain the Prone Condition.
Severed Leg: The leg is Amputated. You gain the Prone Condition and 2 Bleeding Conditions.
